text:
Celeste Ng: Observing weird authz variance when requests pass hosted->dedicated->private over streaming RPCs. Need to decide envelope semantics and precedence rules.
Aaron Blake: Can we encode a connection-bound reference instead of resending full assertion per message? That'd help streams.
Ivy Patel: Connection ref OK, but still need a way to refresh proof without tearing down stream. proof token with rotation window seems fine.
Tom Novak: Private deployments insist on local KMS verification. If adapter re-signs we must ensure monotonic semantics. Propose a "no-escalation" invariant in the contract.
Celeste Ng: Also need to handle clock skew between control plane and private adapters. TTLs must accommodate small skew and we should support "leeway" validation parameter.
Aaron Blake: Header name idea: X-RW-Envelop (short). Payload: {aid, tid, caller, flags, exp}. We compact B64 it and include alg metadata.
Ivy Patel: Suggest algs: HS (platform hmac) for hosted, RS/ES for KMS-signed assertions in private. Verifier libs must support both and fall back to JWKS caching.
Tom Novak: Precedence: if both old multi-headers and new envelope present, envelope takes precedence unless runtime in compat-mode. Define a compat-mode for 8 weeks.
Celeste Ng: For streams use X-RW-Conn:aid=...,proof=...,rot=60. Proof rotates every 60s. Proxy refreshes automatically.
Aaron Blake: Edge-case: adapter offline mid-translation. Should adapters allow degraded-mode where they accept platform-signed assertion only if tenant opted-in and emit degraded audit event.
Ivy Patel: Yes, but default should be strict reject. Degraded-mode must be explicit per-tenant and time-limited.
Tom Novak: Audit schema must include orig_aid, new_aid, adapter_id, reason, mapping_diff, and a flag "degraded=true|false". Emit metrics for mismatches.
Celeste Ng: Also add a small integration test: hosted->dedicated->private where adapter drops a 'no-log' flag; verifier must reject.
infra-bot: Created task HST-12002 in hosting-handbook: "Envelope precedence, conn-binding, clock-leeway, and adapter degraded-mode" assigned to @Celeste Ng and @Tom Novak.
Aaron Blake: Action items: Celeste -> RFC for envelope grammar + precedence; Tom -> adapter contract and mapping table; Ivy -> verifier lib + jwks cache; Aaron -> e2e stream tests. Target: staging canary in 3w.
Ivy Patel: I'll include fuzz tests for truncated/malformed envelopes.
Celeste Ng: Thanks, will post RFC link when ready. :thumbsup:
